en: AI helped us build. We chose what mattered.
zh: AI让想法落地，判断让作品成立。
en_script:
You have seen Civilization Voyage in action.
I will now explain how we built it, where it fits in the market, and how it could support a lasting business.

We used Lovable to exchange ideas, Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.
We integrated the work locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.
AI accelerated production. Our team remained responsible for the experience: selecting stories, checking historical order, and making choices understandable.

The image on the right shows the result: a playable product.
The next task is to earn the player's time, then their purchase.
That takes a clear reason to choose us and an experience worth returning to.
Our business plan starts with that reason to choose us.
zh_script: 大家已经看到了文明航程的实际体验。接下来介绍我们如何制作、如何定位，以及如何支撑持续经营。我们用Lovable交流想法，Claude做设计，Codex处理API，Grok完成前端与3D；在本机整合、测试并更新桌面应用。AI加快了制作，团队仍负责选故事、核对历史顺序、让玩家理解选择。右侧是已经可以玩的产品。下一步是争取玩家的时间，再赢得购买；这需要明确的选择理由和值得回来的体验。商业计划就从这个理由开始。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 承接前面的游戏演示，面向观众。
rehearsal.en:
You have seen Civilization Voyage in action.
I will now explain how we built it, where it fits in the market, and how it could support a lasting business.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧制作流程，再看右侧游戏实录。
rehearsal.en:
We used Lovable to exchange ideas, Claude for design, Codex for API work, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.
We integrated the work locally, tested the interactions, and updated the desktop app.
AI accelerated production. Our team remained responsible for the experience: selecting stories, checking historical order, and making choices understandable.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右图，然后看向观众；最后一句引出竞品。
rehearsal.en:
The image on the right shows the result: a playable product.
The next task is to earn the player's time, then their purchase.
That takes a clear reason to choose us and an experience worth returning to.
Our business plan starts with that reason to choose us.

zh: 对标竞品，明确我们的优势
en_script:
Discovery Tour competes through historical depth.
Minecraft Education competes through classroom flexibility.
Civilization Voyage focuses on connected stories and choices that carry forward.

Four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes connect Chinese and world histories around technology and human life.
Each route follows a historical sequence. Players make decisions, face the consequences, and review their choices at the end.
Sharing supplies with a village costs resources now, but can bring support later.
That gives the next chapter a personal stake. Players carry their earlier decisions into it.

The line at the bottom captures our position:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
This is the experience we would build our brand around.
Its classroom value still needs testing. Our immediate advantage is a game already organised around this specific cultural journey.
The business model adapts that experience to three customers, each paying for a different outcome.
zh_script: Discovery Tour以历史深度竞争，Minecraft Education以课堂灵活性竞争。文明航程聚焦连贯故事和持续影响后续的选择。四时代、八航线、二十四场景，以技术与人的生活串联中国和世界历史。航线遵循历史顺序，玩家作决定、面对后果、回顾自己的选择。分享补给消耗眼前资源，却可能换来后续支持，让下一章与玩家自己的决定产生关系。底部概括了定位：一段航程、连贯选择、持续后果。这是品牌要围绕的体验。课堂效果仍需测试；目前的优势是已围绕这个具体文化主题组织好的游戏。商业模式将其适配给三类客户，各自为不同结果付费。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左、中两栏，竞品长处各用一句；重心移到右侧。
rehearsal.en:
Discovery Tour competes through historical depth.
Minecraft Education competes through classroom flexibility.
Civilization Voyage focuses on connected stories and choices that carry forward.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右栏的四时代、八航线；例子放慢。
rehearsal.en:
Four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes connect Chinese and world histories around technology and human life.
Each route follows a historical sequence. Players make decisions, face the consequences, and review their choices at the end.
Sharing supplies with a village costs resources now, but can bring support later.
That gives the next chapter a personal stake. Players carry their earlier decisions into it.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指底部一句话，停顿后衔接三种产品。
rehearsal.en:
The line at the bottom captures our position:
One journey. Connected choices. Consequences that follow you.
This is the experience we would build our brand around.
Its classroom value still needs testing. Our immediate advantage is a game already organised around this specific cultural journey.
The business model adapts that experience to three customers, each paying for a different outcome.

en: One core experience. Three reasons to pay.
zh: 共同的内容基础，三种付费理由。
en_script:
For players, we sell the adventure.
The proposed price is sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
A clear offer makes the first purchase simple. Additional story packs could generate repeat purchases once the game has earned an audience.
That puts enjoyment and return visits at the centre of the consumer business.

For educators, we sell help using the game in class.
The middle image turns an industrial story into a discussion guide. It connects the experience to a lesson the teacher can lead.
Our proposed annual fee is twelve thousand yuan per institution, covering guides, two training sessions, and defined support.
Renewal depends on repeated use. We would test that before expanding the service.

For museums, we sell a local story visitors can take part in.
The proposed project fee is sixty thousand yuan: one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
Education and museum services remain proposals. All prices need validation.
Across the three offers, the goal is to reuse research and game systems while charging for adaptation and support.
We would price extra work separately, so custom projects do not consume the margin.
That delivery discipline is essential to the numbers on the next slide.
zh_script: 玩家买冒险：完整游戏拟价68元，明确的商品便于首次购买，积累受众后再通过故事包争取复购。乐趣和回访是消费者业务的核心。教育者买课堂应用支持：中图把工业故事变成教师可以带领的讨论，机构拟议年费1.2万元，含指南、两次培训及限定支持。续费依赖反复使用，扩张前先验证。博物馆买观众可以参与的本地故事：拟议项目费6万元，限定一个主题、三个场景、两轮审读。教育和文博仍是规划，所有价格有待验证。三类业务共同复用研究与系统，同时对适配和支持收费。额外工作单独计价，防止定制吞掉利润。下一页的数字说明交付纪律为何关键。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧游戏实录与薄荷绿价格。
rehearsal.en:
For players, we sell the adventure.
The proposed price is sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
A clear offer makes the first purchase simple. Additional story packs could generate repeat purchases once the game has earned an audience.
That puts enjoyment and return visits at the centre of the consumer business.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指中间课堂讨论概念图及年费。
rehearsal.en:
For educators, we sell help using the game in class.
The middle image turns an industrial story into a discussion guide. It connects the experience to a lesson the teacher can lead.
Our proposed annual fee is twelve thousand yuan per institution, covering guides, two training sessions, and defined support.
Renewal depends on repeated use. We would test that before expanding the service.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧文博展陈概念图，最后回到三栏整体。
rehearsal.en:
For museums, we sell a local story visitors can take part in.
The proposed project fee is sixty thousand yuan: one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
Education and museum services remain proposals. All prices need validation.
Across the three offers, the goal is to reuse research and game systems while charging for adaptation and support.
We would price extra work separately, so custom projects do not consume the margin.
That delivery discipline is essential to the numbers on the next slide.

en: Growth must pay for the work behind it
zh: 增长，要能承担持续创作的成本。
en_script:
Our base case models one year: two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
That produces three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in revenue.
These figures are planning assumptions, not recorded sales.

Follow the chart from left to right.
Delivery and customer acquisition reduce revenue to a contribution of one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
Fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan then leaves a loss of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.
The base case does not yet cover the cost of building the business.

Our priorities follow directly from that gap: control acquisition costs, reuse teaching content, and keep museum delivery within scope.
Larger orders help only if they leave enough money after delivery.
We would track contribution per customer alongside repeat purchases and renewals.
Expansion should follow evidence that those measures are improving.
That is why we propose releasing funds in stages.
zh_script: 基准情况测算一年：两千名付费玩家、十家机构、两个文博项目，收入37.6万元。这是规划假设，并非已实现销售。沿图从左向右，扣除交付和获客成本，贡献为16.08万元；再扣24万元固定投入，亏损7.92万元。基准尚未覆盖建设业务的成本。因此重点是控制获客成本、复用教学内容、限制文博交付范围。大订单只有在扣除交付后留下足够收益才有帮助。我们会同时看每类客户的贡献、复购和续费，依据这些指标改善的证据决定扩张，所以资金要分阶段释放。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指顶部销量假设，然后指蓝柱。
rehearsal.en:
Our base case models one year: two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
That produces three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in revenue.
These figures are planning assumptions, not recorded sales.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 从蓝柱沿图向右，红色亏损处停顿。
rehearsal.en:
Follow the chart from left to right.
Delivery and customer acquisition reduce revenue to a contribution of one hundred and sixty thousand eight hundred yuan.
Fixed investment of two hundred and forty thousand yuan then leaves a loss of seventy-nine thousand two hundred yuan.
The base case does not yet cover the cost of building the business.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 面向观众，说清楚经营结论；最后引出资金计划。
rehearsal.en:
Our priorities follow directly from that gap: control acquisition costs, reuse teaching content, and keep museum delivery within scope.
Larger orders help only if they leave enough money after delivery.
We would track contribution per customer alongside repeat purchases and renewals.
Expansion should follow evidence that those measures are improving.
That is why we propose releasing funds in stages.

zh: 让人愿意再来，让故事能够继续。
en_script:
The proposed funding envelope is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
It covers fixed work, delivery cash flow, and a reserve.
Delivery cash flow bridges the wait for customer payment; it is not an additional expense in the previous chart.
We would commit one hundred and twenty thousand yuan first.

The sequence on the right guides that investment.
First, improve completion and voluntary return.
Next, test paid offers and measure delivery costs.
Then, release further funds when the evidence supports expansion.
Each project should add reusable content, customer knowledge, and stronger partnerships.
Over time, that gives us a growing collection of cultural experiences, with less work repeated from scratch.
The aim is a business that can fund the next story—and keep improving the game.
zh_script: 拟议资金总额36万元，覆盖固定工作、交付现金周转和储备。周转用于弥补等待客户付款的时间，不是上一页额外增加的费用。先投入12万元，按右侧顺序：改善完成率与主动回访；测试付费方案、测量交付成本；证据支持时再释放后续资金。每个项目都应积累可复用内容、客户认知和伙伴关系，逐步形成更丰富的文化体验，减少从头再做的工作。目标是让业务能够支持下一个故事，并不断改善游戏。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧36万元资金规划与三根条。
rehearsal.en:
The proposed funding envelope is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
It covers fixed work, delivery cash flow, and a reserve.
Delivery cash flow bridges the wait for customer payment; it is not an additional expense in the previous chart.
We would commit one hundred and twenty thousand yuan first.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 沿右侧三个阶段向下讲。
rehearsal.en:
The sequence on the right guides that investment.
First, improve completion and voluntary return.
Next, test paid offers and measure delivery costs.
Then, release further funds when the evidence supports expansion.
Each project should add reusable content, customer knowledge, and stronger partnerships.
Over time, that gives us a growing collection of cultural experiences, with less work repeated from scratch.
The aim is a business that can fund the next story—and keep improving the game.

en_script:
Civilization Voyage begins with Chinese civilization and opens onto the world.
Technology changes what people can do. Our stories explore what they choose to do with that power.
We want players to remember the people behind the history—and their own choices along the way.
A lasting business lets us keep those stories alive.
Thank you.
zh_script: 文明航程从中华文明出发，走向世界。技术改变人们能够做什么，我们的故事关注人们选择怎样使用这种能力。我们希望玩家记住历史中的人，也记住自己一路作出的选择。持续的经营，让这些故事继续生长。谢谢。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 切到全屏神殿与航船，放慢语速，面向观众结束。
rehearsal.en:
Civilization Voyage begins with Chinese civilization and opens onto the world.
Technology changes what people can do. Our stories explore what they choose to do with that power.
We want players to remember the people behind the history—and their own choices along the way.
A lasting business lets us keep those stories alive.
Thank you.
